summary: The note is a short introduction to the list of United Kingdom ambassadors to France. It states that the Embassy to France has traditionally been the most prestigious posting in the British foreign service. It also notes that diplomatic representation was sometimes lacking in past centuries because of wars between the two countries and the Nazi occupation.
one_line: Introduction to the list of British ambassadors to France, noting the posting's prestige and gaps in representation caused by wars and occupation.
key_facts: The Embassy to France has traditionally been the most prestigious posting in the British foreign service.
In past centuries, diplomatic representation between the United Kingdom and France was lacking.
Diplomatic representation was lacking in past centuries due to wars between the two countries.
Diplomatic representation was lacking in past centuries due to the Nazi occupation.
